generatorView.description: A feed a client can offer the viewer, with its ranking method disclosed. Mirrors the social.openreel.feed.generator record, plus the AT-URI to pass to getFeed and, for weighted feeds, the weights applied.

uri.description: AT-URI of the social.openreel.feed.generator record; the 'feed' parameter of getFeed.

rankingCriteria.description: Self-declared family of ranking method; see social.openreel.feed.generator.

weights.description: The signals a weighted feed scores posts by and how much each counts. Absent for feeds that are not a weighted sum, such as chronological ones.

rankingWeight.description: One term of a weighted feed's score. Each signal is normalized to 0-1 before weighting.

signal.description: 'views' is a post's view count (indexed social.openreel.engagement.watchEvent records) relative to the most-viewed post; 'recency' decays from 1 by half every halfLifeHours.

weightBps.description: Share of the score in basis points; a feed's weights sum to 10000.

halfLifeHours.description: For time-decayed signals such as 'recency': hours for the signal to fall by half.
